Deploy NexFiscal Front — produção

Arquivo:
    .github/workflows/docker.yml

Fluxo:
    Push na main → Build Docker (Nitro node-server) → Push GHCR → SSH → Pull → Restart container

Container:
    nexfiscal-front-prod
    Porta host: 3010 (container escuta na 80)
    Rede Docker: network-nexfiscal

GitHub — environment "prod":
    Secrets:
        SERVER_HOST
        SERVER_USER
        SERVER_SSH_KEY
        SERVER_PORT
    Variables:
        VITE_API_URL (ex: https://api.nexfiscal.com.br/api)
